issue_context.title: chore: use WaitForCacheSync method after sharedInformerFactory Start in integration or unit test follow-ups
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

In unit tests and integration tests, after the informer calls the Start method, many files do not call the WaitForCacheSync method to wait for the informer to synchronize.
We should use `WaitForCacheSync` method after sharedInformerFactory `Start`

example: (I just gave examples, not all)

- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/podautoscaler/horizontal_test.go#L809

- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/test/e2e_node/services/namespace_controller.go#L85

- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/resourcequota/resource_quota_controller_test.go#L134

### Why is this needed?

We should use `WaitForCacheSync` method after sharedInformerFactory `Start`

Because it involves multiple sigs groups, PRs need to be submitted separately, so this issue is used for tracking.
